title: Tag state-lock Held/Waited diagnostics with the initiating operation so live holds can be attributed
outcome: Each state-lock Held/Waited diagnostic line names, besides its acquisition site, a bounded static tag for the operation that initiated the lock (e.g. api:session_tail, api:summary_snapshot, delegation:refresh_child, engram:checkpoint_confirm), propagated through snapshot wrappers and worker hand-offs. Live holds like Greg's 330–349 ms entries can then be attributed to an entry kind without guessing.
acceptance: Every StateMutex Held/Waited report carries the existing acquisition site plus a bounded static initiating-operation tag; an untagged acquisition reports an explicit 'untagged' value rather than omitting the field. Tests cover a tagged direct lock, a tag propagated through the snapshot()/summary_snapshot() wrappers, and one propagated across a spawn_blocking or worker hand-off.
The tags are static strings only: no session ids, prompts, paths, tokens or other request content, and the reporter's queue stays bounded. A test pins the reporter output shape.

The change adds no measurable work under the lock beyond carrying the tag, and the existing hold-measurement behaviour and thresholds are unchanged; any change to thresholds or a per-request correlation id is out of scope for this item.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding and the full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
disposal_reason: Greg's direction relayed by Engram::Advisor (TermAl mailbox b9d13887 #2895, 17:03Z): 'nie, lepsze podejscie bedzie z kodu … Nie zaczynac od nowej diagnostyki/logowania; profil tylko jesli analiza i poprawki nie wystarcza.' The work is redirected to code fixes that remove the expensive operations under the lock at the repeatedly logged sites. A diagnostic or profile capture comes only if those fixes prove insufficient.
